newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold volume falls, prices mixed.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold volume falls, prices mixed.

text.p: Traded volume on Istanbul's gold exchange dived to 930 kilos on Thursday from a record 2,570 kilos on Wednesday as banks' activity faded, dealers said.
Volume had surged to a record as banks dealt actively to benefit from lower gold prices and rising lira/dollar rates by buying in dollar terms and selling in lira.
Dealers said the market was quiet today and much of the trade was based on free market demand.
Gold closed at $356.00 an ounce, down from Wednesday's $356.80 in line with European trends. But it firmed to 1,266,800 lira per gram from 1,263,500 due to a sharply weaker Turkish lira.
The lira ended at 110,475 to the dollar due to the U.S. currency's gains in world markets, after Wednesday's 110,010.
There was 480 kilos of trade in the morning session and 450 in the afternoon. 57 percent of turnover was made lira terms. --Istanbul newsroom +90 212 275 0875
